facts.fact: Le Grand Ouémé reports Moov Money Bénin's app now offers customers instant transfers, as the sole e-money issuer currently eligible for the service.

Le Grand Ouémé reports Moov Money customers can make instant transfers between their Moov Money account and all bank and microfinance accounts connected to PI-SPI across the UEMOA zone, and BOA-Bénin customers can send and receive instant payments to and from other connected providers.
